content.short: RealT is a real estate tokenization platform that enables fractional ownership of US properties on-chain.
content.description:
RealT is a pioneering decentralized platform designed to democratize access to the real estate market by tokenizing US-based properties on the Ethereum and Gnosis blockchains. The protocol allows investors worldwide to purchase "RealTokens," representing fractional ownership in specific residential or commercial assets. This approach significantly lowers the barrier to entry for property investment, enabling participants to build a diversified real estate portfolio with a single transaction.

Investors in RealT properties receive a share of the rental income, which is paid out weekly in stablecoins directly to their digital wallets. The platform focuses on professional-grade transparency and regulatory compliance, ensuring that every digital token is backed by a verifiable legal interest in the physical property. Through its commitment to making real estate liquid and accessible, RealT is building the essential infrastructure for a more inclusive global property economy, where traditional stability meets decentralized innovation.
content.meta: RealT provides fractional real estate tokenization and stablecoin rental yields on Ethereum and Gnosis.
